Invited Lecture

Title: Legendre Polynomials

Abstract: These polynomials are introduced by the French mathematician Adrien-Marie Legendre close to 250 years ago. They come up in almost all areas of mathematics (and in other sciences and engineering too). We will discuss some basic properties of these polynomials and time permitting illustrate a few ways in which they appear in algebra and number theory.
